$comment: Clone groups of scripts/audit/clones_struct.mjs kept on purpose. A group is silenced when EVERY copy's file matches one of `files` (and, with `name`, one copy is that function). Triaged 2026-10-24 (docs/code-audit.md).

entries.reason: persona-cards result storage mirrored by the SPA and the stream Lambda (both write the same session), pinned by personaResult.lockstep.test.ts; separate packages that must not import each other. One source is possible but needs a build-config change the owner decides on: the SPA importing the stream file pulls a second zod copy into its bundle (+86 KB, +24 KB gzip, measured on contract.ts) unless vite.config.ts and vitest.config.ts get resolve.dedupe ['zod'], and the shared file must stay browser-safe (zod only).

approval-card bounds mirrored from the stream tool schema, pinned by its lockstep test. One source is possible but needs a build-config change the owner decides on: the SPA importing the stream file pulls a second zod copy into its bundle (+86 KB, +24 KB gzip, measured on contract.ts) unless vite.config.ts and vitest.config.ts get resolve.dedupe ['zod'], and the shared file must stay browser-safe (zod only).

Radar brand-list bounds (languages, feed URL shape) mirrored from the stream tool schema and shared/radar_brand_fields.py, pinned by radarSchemas.lockstep.test.ts; separate packages that must not import each other. One source is possible but needs a build-config change the owner decides on: the SPA importing the stream file pulls a second zod copy into its bundle (+86 KB, +24 KB gzip, measured on contract.ts) unless vite.config.ts and vitest.config.ts get resolve.dedupe ['zod'], and the shared file must stay browser-safe (zod only).

the agent heartbeat and the memory scanner: the construct calls are already shared (workerRole, createWorkerFunction, scheduleWorker); what is left is each function's own grants, env and schedule, which is the 20 KB IAM split (one function, one role) and must stay per function; logical ids are pinned by the CDK tests

update_scraper vs update_user executors: the shown-record re-check is one helper (shown.ts requireUnchangedSinceShown); what is left is the flow shape, with different steps between it (scraper: merge + record validation + one save; user: self-change refusal + ordered multi-route apply), routes, messages and summaries

both draw through components/FormQrCode/QrPanel; what is left is each wrapper building its own URL (the API host form page vs the SPA ballot route, deliberately not one "id + kind" component, see SessionQrCode's header) and its own words and tones (the ballot one also prints the URL)

get_agent / get_project / get_product_context: the tool-definition skeleton every server tool has (toolSpec, serverTool, parseToolInput, resolveId are already shared); the description, pack, route, answer shape and side effect (projectAccess.record) differ per tool

the prioritization list's empty card (centred, icon tile, h2) and the public ballot's recorded notice (role=status, ok-toned banner, icon beside the text): different layout, role and tone; only the 'icon + title + text' shape matches

the S3 empty-folder note (centred, bare icon, two lines) and the jobs section header (row with an icon tile and an h2): different layout and heading semantics; only the 'icon + two lines' shape matches

icon badges over two enums (decision verdict, run outcome). FIXABLE-LATER: an IconBadge component (tone class, icon, label) would serve these and ~19 other 'badge inline-flex items-center gap-1' sites; do it as one sweep

two three-way enum -> icon switches (trend up/down/flat at 14 px, onboarding step done/pending/todo at 20 px with a spinner): different icons, sizes and classes; a shared helper would be a lookup table as long as each switch
